## Summary

[Partial] Install a braided line and heat-diff-side-tube end if necessary for an ARB's anti-kink spring. [t440]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Install a braided line to serve as protection and an anti-kink mechanism for the main air hose.
2. Heat the end of the diff-side tube if necessary to slide in ARB's anti-kink spring.

_Procedure reported by [t440]._
